piping system for evacuation and gas filling is shown in figure 8.

Remove the front cover and 
remove the cover of stop valve (81) (see figure 9)

Connect the gas supplying 
adaptor (82) to body of stop valve (83) when high pressure SF6 is filled in the 
grounded tanks (20) start following procedure after exhausting if according to 
step 2,3 in the above procedures, and confirm the pressure switch (25) operates between 3.0 and 3.2 
kg/cm2

Turn the nut (84) 
clockwise to the red line of this adaptor (82)

Close the stop valve 
(85),(86) and the stop valve of cylinder (87), and open the stop valve (88), 
then operate vacuum pump (89)

vacuum pump (89) still more 1 hour

Close the stop valve (88) 
and release the leak valve of the vacuum pump (89), then stop the operation of 
the vacuum pump (89)

Decide 
replenishing pressure referring to the SF6 gas pressure-temperature 
characteristic curve as shown in fig 10

cylinder (87) and stop valve (85) SF6 gas is filling to the piping of the 
breaker

During gas filling, 
confirm switching of the pressure switch (25) between 3.84.2kg/cm2
When 
replenishing pressure is lower than switching pressure of the pressure switch 
(25), fill SF6 gas to switching 
pressure, 
confirm its switching operation, and exhaust SF6 gas to replenishing pressure.
